profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in C/C++, python, firmware, bare-metal, tls, x509, encryption/decryption and Doors. Strong engineering professional with a Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) focused in Electrical Engineering from The University of Texas at Arlington.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Missile Defense Software, writing requirements in Doors.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and expanded scope of UEFI driver firmware designed to secure PC in pre-boot environment. Member of UEFI and attended UEFI Plugfest 2016 and 2018. Extended linux kernel python code run in pre-boot (before main OS) to supplement firmware driver code. Have been, since starting at Def-Logix, main or only development engineer for the firmware part of the project. This project has received funding multiple times for research and is going commercial. Firmware coding using C language and built on Tianocore UDK (bare metal). Debugging does not have the luxury of an IDE (none available).
Very familiar with pre-boot and BIOS level system vulnerabilities and how to mitigate.
Familiar with TLS, x509, openssl, Windows registry hive files, encryption/decryption.

positions.title: Professor
positions.description:
Taught telecommunications senior level courses for EET majors. Taught programming courses (C++ and Java) for EET(electronics engineering technology), CET(computer engineering technology) and BMET(bio-medical engineering technology) majors. Have been the main or only Professor teaching all programming courses for xET students (EET, CET, BMET). Taught algorithms/data structures course and software engineering course specifically for CET majors. Was CET chair in Electronics dept. when we had an on-campus dept. Worked initially with other Devry professors to refine CET curriculum before rolling out to all the campuses.
Upgraded teaching style over the years for programming courses so that now only points given in a course when that is the result of the student writing code. No longer have multiple choice quizzes/exams or homework involving definition or identification or otherwise. All assignments are the result of the student writing code only. The results are that the students are much better prepared for later courses involving the need to write or modify software and work in senior project.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on GSM 3G system software design, CDMA system software test, and was the only manager of software server used to track source code modifications and interdependency with other code. This software was called "Doors" and quite helpful. GSM work included writing code to store and retrieve user data based on identity number using a tree structure. CDMA work included developing a test bed for stress testing the system software using 30 hand-held phones driven by a single PC.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description: Worked in many capacities including software design and test engineer, software support and liaison with engineers in U.S. firms. Designed test beds for ethernet smart hubs. Wrote testing programs with C and some C++ OO code. Worked support for Hewlett Packard (HP) smart hubs closely coordinating with HP employees in Roseville, California.
